desc: We hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at the meeting held today, i.e., Tuesday, August 25, 2026, inter alia considered and approved, Thursday, September 17, 2026, as the Record Date for determining the members eligible for payment of the final dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
